name: kumo
description: Organize local Kumo web clips into traceable domain knowledge and reuse them in real tasks.

interface.longDescription: Kumo helps you retrieve saved web clips and build evidence-backed domain knowledge. It reads a user-authorized local Kumo library, preserves original sources and manual classifications, and supports derived organization only when separately enabled and requested. Requires a local desktop executor and Node.js 22+. This package does not make a local library available to the ChatGPT website or host a cloud AI service. The interface and skills support Chinese workflows.
defaultPrompt: 帮我找收藏里适合当前任务的参考，并读取原文。
整理我的 Kumo 新收藏，编译领域知识并更新关联，保留原件和人工分类。
检查 Kumo 连接，说明当前资料库和可用的读写权限。
